full_judgment: 3. Mr. Fazlul Karim, learned Advocate appearing in support of this Rule, has taken us through the relevant papers including the impugned order. The petitioner was proceeded against on certain specific charges one of which was that he had made a report to the authorities showing 3602 acres of Government Khas land as a "tenanted land" that is, land which was already leased out to tenants. As he denied the charges a regular enquiry was held by the Addl. Dy. Commissioner. Rajshahi, who allowed him opportunity to make his defence and recorded evidence in his presence On conclusion of the enquiry, the Addl. Dy. Commissioner submitted a report finding him guilty of only one charge, that is, of falsely showing Government khas land as tenanted land. The Additional Commissioner, who is the "authority" as referred to in Rule 2(e), accepted the report and imposed the penalty as per his impugned order (Annexure 'E'). Being aggrieved the petitioner made an appeal before the Board of Revenue but the learned Member of the Board of Revenue by his order dated 10-7-69 dismissed the appeal observing that there was hardly anything wrong in the order of the Additional Commissioner. In these circumstances this Court was moved and the Rule obtained.
